input_zh: Reading 权威控制固定于受治理恢复 Worker Claimed 后的 main 提交 f0beb13715ed2bdae19d26b2b781c1164356a07d：Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Reading Prompt v1.0.0（SHA-256 为 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5）及同一提交上的全部 5 个 requiredSources。Reading 只消费同日 Completed Queue Plan 中已选择的 Q-20260912-01 与 Q-20260912-02。原始同日 Reading Wake Receipt 已从 research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-12/reading-105956.json 核验。先前 Claimed Epoch 超出租约，Scheduler 于 15:01:45+08:00 打开受治理恢复槽；恢复业务前，fresh Worker Claimed 已在提交 f0beb13715ed2bdae19d26b2b781c1164356a07d 持久记录。
workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both selected objects. Q-20260912-01 preserves the primary study's evidence-ablation, planner-reliability and fixed-intent execution-guard results, including the negative finding that a typed relation did not outperform equal raw receipts and the boundary that a guard cannot manufacture a missing valid intent. Q-20260912-02 inspected the exact merged Codex, MCP TypeScript SDK and Gemini CLI changes and their tests. Codex revalidates retained provider selection/definition against current managed requirements before selected model-driving or state-changing operations, fails closed on mismatch or requirement-load error, avoids queue/goal mutation on rejection and preserves stop controls. MCP constructs Headers from caller input and then case-insensitively sets runtime-managed Authorization, protocol-version and session-id values, preserving configured Authorization only until the provider has a token. Gemini CLI denies sandbox access to credential, trust, policy-integrity and environment-secret state, sanitizes sandbox settings, and permits user-global commands while excluding project/extension commands in untrusted folders. The samples support three bounded patterns—revalidation, deterministic replacement and isolation—but are first-party engineering evidence at different layers, not independent proof of one universal architecture. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
workResult_zh: 已对两个 Selected Object 完成来源完整 Deep Reading。Q-20260912-01 保留一手研究的 Evidence Ablation、Planner Reliability 与 Fixed-intent Execution Guard 结果，包括 Typed Relation 未优于等信息量 Raw Receipt 的负面结果，以及 Guard 无法制造缺失有效 Intent 的边界。Q-20260912-02 检查 Codex、MCP TypeScript SDK 与 Gemini CLI 三个已合并变更的精确实现与测试。Codex 在部分驱动模型或改变状态的操作前，把既有 Provider Selection / Definition 与当前 Managed Requirements 重新校验；Mismatch 或 Requirement-load Error 均失败关闭，拒绝前不修改 Queue / Goal，并保留 Stop Control。MCP 先从 Caller Input 构造 Headers，再以大小写不敏感方式写入 Runtime 管理的 Authorization、Protocol Version 与 Session ID；Provider 尚无 Token 时才保留配置 Authorization。Gemini CLI 禁止 Sandbox 访问 Credential、Trust、Policy-integrity 与 Environment-secret State，清洗 Sandbox Settings，并在不受信目录中允许 User-global Command、排除 Project / Extension Command。三份样本支持 Revalidation、Deterministic Replacement 与 Isolation 三种有界模式，但它们是位于不同层的第一方工程证据，不是某种普适架构的独立证明。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。
